text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi tham gayi,
Tumne sunna nahi, maine kabhi kaha nahi.
Bas faaslon ke darmiyaan ek alag hi ishq panap gaya,
Jo bina kisi naam ke, umar bhar chalta gaya.
title: Ankahi Baatein
description: A soft and heartfelt poetic status about silent love that was never expressed into words, perfect for general Indian audiences on social media.
